attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (opt1/vtnet1, 10.60.1.0/24, node2) and lan-b (opt2/vtnet2, 10.60.2.0/24, node3). Created a single port alias "node3_svc_ports" (8080, 8443, 9000) and one firewall pass rule on the lan-a interface referencing that alias to permit node2->node3 on those ports only. Set up supporting static routes on node2/node3 and opened matching firewalld rich rules on node3 scoped to node2's IP. Verified TCP connectivity succeeds on all three listed ports and fails on an unlisted port (9999). Performed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3, proving changed boot identity on each and confirming full recovery of interfaces, routes, firewall alias/rule, and end-to-end connectivity afterward.
